tailoring.headline: Lead SAP Commerce Cloud Developer | Senior Java & Spring Expert | SAP Certified
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with over 5 years of experience delivering SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, REST/OCC APIs and full-stack development, designing scalable architectures and integrating PIM, ERP and MDM systems. Proven track record in CI/CD, DevOps, code reviews, performance tuning and leading international technical teams across global agile environments.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Lead SAP Commerce Cloud Developer
cover_en.hook: I am excited by Leuchtmehr’s ambition to shape the technical future of a global e-commerce platform. With more than five years delivering SAP Commerce Cloud solutions at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I combine deep Java/Spring expertise with proven architectural leadership.

bullets.label: Architecture & Design
bullets.text: At Rockwell Automation I designed and implemented backend services on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211), creating scalable Java/Spring architectures and OCC REST APIs that support global product and pricing data.

bullets.label: Full-Stack Development
bullets.text: I built end-to-end solutions, from Java-based services to PWA-enabled storefronts, and customized back-office components, ensuring performant full-stack delivery.

bullets.label: Integration & Performance
bullets.text: I engineered PIM-to-Hybris pipelines using Profisee, DataHub and Hotfolders, and optimized database queries, improving response times and data consistency across ERP and MDM systems.

bullets.label: Leadership & Delivery
bullets.text: I led code reviews, established coding guidelines, mentored junior developers and coordinated international teams, driving CI/CD pipelines and production support in agile environments.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, I hold a valid German work permit, am serving notice until 15 December 2026 and can start on 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute to Leuchtmehr.

cover_de.subject: Bewerbung als Lead SAP Commerce Cloud Developer
cover_de.hook: Die Vision von Leuchtmehr, die technische Zukunft einer globalen E-Commerce-Plattform zu gestalten, begeistert mich. Mit über fünf Jahren Erfahrung in der Umsetzung von SAP Commerce Cloud-Lösungen bei Rockwell Automation und Shell bringe ich tiefes Java- und Spring-Know-how sowie nachweisliche Architektur- und Führungsqualitäten mit.

bullets.label: Architektur & Design
bullets.text: Bei Rockwell Automation habe ich Backend-Services auf SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) entworfen und implementiert, skalierbare Java/Spring-Architekturen und OCC-REST-APIs für globale Produkt- und Preisdaten geschaffen.

bullets.label: Full-Stack-Entwicklung
bullets.text: Ich entwickelte End-to-End-Lösungen von Java-basierten Services bis zu PWA-gestützten Storefronts und passte Back-Office-Komponenten an, um eine leistungsfähige Full-Stack-Bereitstellung sicherzustellen.

bullets.label: Integration & Performance
bullets.text: Ich konzipierte PIM-zu-Hybris-Datenpipelines mit Profisee, DataHub und Hotfolders und optimierte Datenbank-Abfragen, wodurch Reaktionszeiten und Datenkonsistenz zwischen ERP- und MDM-Systemen verbessert wurden.

bullets.label: Führung & Lieferung
bullets.text: Ich leitete Code-Reviews, etablierte Coding-Guidelines, betreute Junior-Entwickler und koordinierte internationale Teams, trieb CI/CD-Pipelines und den Produktions-Support in agilen Projekten voran.

cover_de.logistics: Ich lebe in Karlsruhe, besitze eine gültige deutsche Arbeitserlaubnis, befinde mich in der Kündigungsfrist bis zum 15.12.2026 und kann ab dem 16.12.2026 starten. Ich freue mich auf ein Gespräch, um meinen Beitrag für Leuchtmehr zu erläutern.

tailoring.why_company: Leuchtmehr’s focus on innovative, globally-scaled e-commerce solutions aligns perfectly with my passion for building robust SAP Commerce Cloud platforms. The company’s commitment to modern architectures, international roll-outs and continuous delivery resonates with my experience driving large-scale integrations and leading cross-functional teams at Rockwell Automation and Shell. I am eager to contribute to Leuchtmehr’s growth and help shape its digital future.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to leverage my 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud expertise to lead architecture and teams at Leuchtmehr, delivering high-performance, globally-scalable e-commerce solutions.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud developer with 5+ years at Rockwell Automation and Shell. I’m excited about the Lead Developer role at Leuchtmehr and would love to discuss how I can add value. Feel free to connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application – Lead SAP Commerce Cloud Developer
tailoring.email_body: Dear Hiring Team, please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Lead SAP Commerce Cloud Developer position at Leuchtmehr GmbH. With over five years of experience delivering SAP Commerce Cloud solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am confident I can drive architecture, integration and team leadership for your global platform. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss my fit.
